name: Dojo Health Sentinel
description: Reads a Venus lending position market by market, computes health factor and liquidation drawdown, and cross-checks against getAccountLiquidity. Every call returns a receipt.

name: Dojo Yield Scout
description: Ranks Venus stablecoin supply yields with liquidity and price-validity flags; falls back to on-chain rates with the assumption written into the receipt.

name: Dojo Grid Planner
description: Plans a geometric BNB/USDT grid on PancakeSwap from live v2 and v3 prices, sized from a budget, with fee-aware warnings.

name: Dojo Range Keeper
description: Checks a PancakeSwap v3 BNB/USDT position against the live pool tick and proposes a recentred range when it is out or near the edge.
